status: Study-authored operational definitions; not independently human-validated

competencies.title: Enable self-service AI research
competencies.definition: Help other employees conduct research using AI tools, agents, or self-service research frameworks.
include_when: An explicit link between an AI research method/tool and enabling other people to perform research. Coaching or stewardship can qualify without building the technology.
exclude_when: Individual AI use alone; generic research democratization with no AI link; company statements that agents exist without a responsibility for this role.
minimum_evidence: An explicit link between an AI research method/tool and enabling other people to perform research. Coaching or stewardship can qualify without building the technology.

competencies.title: Build research agents and automations
competencies.definition: Build or customize AI-linked research agents, automations, scripts, or integrations.
include_when: Creation or customization of research tooling is explicit, with an AI link established in the passage or directly relevant full-ad context.
exclude_when: Using packaged tools; helping others use existing agents; a repository contribution without implementation evidence; generic automation with no AI link.
minimum_evidence: Creation or customization of research tooling is explicit, with an AI link established in the passage or directly relevant full-ad context.

competencies.title: Set human oversight for research agents
competencies.definition: Determine which research tasks are delegated to AI agents and where human review or intervention is required.
include_when: An explicit decision about research-task allocation, human checkpoints, or oversight of AI-generated research inputs or outputs.
exclude_when: Generic responsible-AI values; validation of an AI product unrelated to the research workflow; merely using an AI tool.
minimum_evidence: An explicit decision about research-task allocation, human checkpoints, or oversight of AI-generated research inputs or outputs.

competencies.title: Contribute to an AI research repository
competencies.definition: Contribute to building or maintaining an AI-enabled research knowledge base or repository.
include_when: The role is linked to contributing to an explicitly AI-enabled research knowledge base; preserve whether this is optional, collaborative, or required.
exclude_when: Ordinary repository use; generic knowledge management; assuming RAG implementation, deployment, or ownership from a request to help.
minimum_evidence: The role is linked to contributing to an explicitly AI-enabled research knowledge base; preserve whether this is optional, collaborative, or required.

competencies.title: Review AI research quality and safeguards
competencies.definition: Review AI-assisted research for explicit quality, privacy, or ethical safeguards.
include_when: At least one concrete safeguard applied to AI-assisted research: source grounding, accuracy, hallucination/bias checks, participant privacy, or accountable human interpretation.
exclude_when: A generic rigor or ethics claim without an AI-research link; AI synthesis alone; employer policy or recruitment safeguards unrelated to the researcher’s work.
minimum_evidence: At least one concrete safeguard applied to AI-assisted research: source grounding, accuracy, hallucination/bias checks, participant privacy, or accountable human interpretation.

competencies.title: Support continuous discovery with AI
competencies.definition: Use AI-linked research methods in repeatable discovery or feedback processes.
include_when: AI-enabled research is explicitly linked to continuous discovery, recurring feedback loops, or an ongoing research workflow.
exclude_when: One-off AI analysis; ordinary continuous discovery with no AI link; inferring a weekly cadence, autonomous operation, or demonstrated quality.
minimum_evidence: AI-enabled research is explicitly linked to continuous discovery, recurring feedback loops, or an ongoing research workflow.

competencies.title: Conduct AI-assisted research synthesis
competencies.definition: Use AI to analyze or synthesize research material into patterns, themes, summaries, or insights.
include_when: A role-linked AI method or tool is explicitly applied to research analysis or synthesis; a generic AI-tool list is insufficient.
exclude_when: A product generating summaries for customers; conventional statistical analysis alone; inferring source verification or human review from synthesis itself.
minimum_evidence: A role-linked AI method or tool is explicitly applied to research analysis or synthesis; a generic AI-tool list is insufficient.

competencies.title: Support AI-moderated usability research
competencies.definition: Conduct or contribute to usability research in which AI performs moderation.
include_when: AI moderation is explicitly linked to usability research or a usability-research roadmap; support responsibilities qualify as contribution.
exclude_when: AI-assisted analysis alone; unmoderated testing alone; synthetic respondents; inferring tool implementation, respondent recruitment, or sole study ownership.
minimum_evidence: AI moderation is explicitly linked to usability research or a usability-research roadmap; support responsibilities qualify as contribution.

competencies.title: Build prototypes with AI coding tools
competencies.definition: Use AI coding tools to create working prototypes.
include_when: An explicit AI-coding or vibe-coding link to a working/code-based prototype. Record an alternative qualification as alternative, not a duty.
exclude_when: AI-generated images or wireframes without code; technical fluency alone; assuming production delivery or a research-evidence basis.
minimum_evidence: An explicit AI-coding or vibe-coding link to a working/code-based prototype. Record an alternative qualification as alternative, not a duty.

competencies.title: Prototype from research evidence
competencies.definition: Use AI to build prototypes explicitly informed by research evidence or insights.
include_when: AI-assisted prototyping is linked to an existing body of research insights or to illustrating research recommendations.
exclude_when: Generic AI prototyping without that link; treating every prototype as research-based; requiring coded or production software without evidence.
minimum_evidence: AI-assisted prototyping is linked to an existing body of research insights or to illustrating research recommendations.

competencies.title: Create AI-assisted concepts for testing
competencies.definition: Use AI to create concepts or prototype directions intended for comparison with users.
include_when: AI-assisted concept/wireframe/prototype creation and a user-testing or comparative-concept purpose are both explicit in connected context.
exclude_when: Image generation without a testing purpose; testing concepts with no AI creation link; assuming executable code.
minimum_evidence: AI-assisted concept/wireframe/prototype creation and a user-testing or comparative-concept purpose are both explicit in connected context.

competencies.title: Build synthetic customer models
competencies.definition: Build AI-linked representations that simulate or predict customer responses.
include_when: Creating synthetic customer models or predictive customer-response simulations is explicit, and directly relevant full-ad context links AI to that modeling/simulation work. Record the model mechanism as unspecified unless identified.
exclude_when: AI moderation; ordinary personas or segmentation without simulated/predictive customer behavior; assuming LLM respondents or substitution for human participants.
minimum_evidence: Creating synthetic customer models or predictive customer-response simulations is explicit, and directly relevant full-ad context links AI to that modeling/simulation work. Record the model mechanism as unspecified unless identified.

competencies.title: Explore AI-assisted journey simulation
competencies.definition: Explore or apply AI-linked simulations or dynamic models of multi-step user journeys.
include_when: AI-linked journey or experience modeling explicitly includes simulation, agent-based representations, or dynamic journey models.
exclude_when: Ordinary journey maps; general persona generation; assuming a deployed synthetic-user system or predictive validity.
minimum_evidence: AI-linked journey or experience modeling explicitly includes simulation, agent-based representations, or dynamic journey models.

competencies.title: Validate simulations against real behavior
competencies.definition: Compare customer simulations or predictive methods with observed behavior or known outcomes.
include_when: Validation against observed behavior/outcomes or investigation of predicted-versus-observed divergence is explicit in an AI-linked customer-modeling context.
exclude_when: Creating synthetic models without validation; general model accuracy language; communicating confidence alone without a linked validation activity.
minimum_evidence: Validation against observed behavior/outcomes or investigation of predicted-versus-observed divergence is explicit in an AI-linked customer-modeling context.

competencies.title: Develop AI evaluation criteria and materials
competencies.definition: Develop user-centered criteria, rubrics, measurement frameworks, or evaluation datasets for AI experiences.
include_when: At least one evaluation artifact is explicitly linked to AI behavior or user experience. Code the named artifact rather than requiring both rubrics and datasets.
exclude_when: Generic research evaluation; AI familiarity alone; treating a preferred familiarity with datasets as a duty to build datasets.
minimum_evidence: At least one evaluation artifact is explicitly linked to AI behavior or user experience. Code the named artifact rather than requiring both rubrics and datasets.

competencies.title: Validate LLM-as-judge evaluations
competencies.definition: Assess or calibrate automated or LLM-based evaluators against relevant human judgments.
include_when: Validation/calibration of automated or LLM judges against human judgment is explicit; qualification-level contribution can qualify with that status retained.
exclude_when: Using AI to score outputs without judge validation; general human-in-the-loop language; ordinary product-summary fact checking.
minimum_evidence: Validation/calibration of automated or LLM judges against human judgment is explicit; qualification-level contribution can qualify with that status retained.

competencies.title: Analyze conversational AI failures
competencies.definition: Analyze conversational AI transcripts or evaluation signals for quality problems and failures.
include_when: Conversation/transcript analysis or annotation is tied to AI quality, fallback, hallucination, refusal, or failure-related signals.
exclude_when: Generic conversation research; conversational-product background without assigned analysis; assuming model development ownership.
minimum_evidence: Conversation/transcript analysis or annotation is tied to AI quality, fallback, hallucination, refusal, or failure-related signals.

competencies.title: Study human–AI interaction
competencies.definition: Investigate how people collaborate with, supervise, delegate to, or recover from AI systems.
include_when: A research or evaluation activity explicitly concerns human interaction with AI, including control, orientation, review, or recovery.
exclude_when: Generic user research at an AI company; assigning design ownership from a research contribution; research automation without an AI-product interaction question.
minimum_evidence: A research or evaluation activity explicitly concerns human interaction with AI, including control, orientation, review, or recovery.

competencies.title: Build dashboards for AI experience metrics
competencies.definition: Create instrumentation or reporting for measures of AI-product experience and outcomes.
include_when: The role creates instrumentation, dashboards, or reporting explicitly tied to an AI product’s experience, behavior, adoption, or outcomes.
exclude_when: Conventional research dashboards with no AI-product link; assuming the dashboard is created using AI; product marketing without reporting duties.
minimum_evidence: The role creates instrumentation, dashboards, or reporting explicitly tied to an AI product’s experience, behavior, adoption, or outcomes.

competencies.title: Evaluate AI adoption and outcomes
competencies.definition: Evaluate the adoption, performance, or consequences of AI tools or initiatives to inform organizational decisions.
include_when: A role-linked evaluation of AI tools/pilots/rollouts or a measurement of their adoption/outcomes is explicit.
exclude_when: Company adoption claims; purchasing AI without evaluation; requiring experimental designs or proof of successful adoption when not stated.
minimum_evidence: A role-linked evaluation of AI tools/pilots/rollouts or a measurement of their adoption/outcomes is explicit.

competencies.title: Synthesize research with AI
competencies.definition: Use AI to analyze or synthesize research material into design-relevant patterns, summaries, or insights.
include_when: AI use is explicitly tied to research analysis or synthesis in the designer’s work.
exclude_when: AI product summaries; generic AI familiarity; automatically crediting verification, bias checks, or traceability.
minimum_evidence: AI use is explicitly tied to research analysis or synthesis in the designer’s work.

competencies.title: Explore design alternatives with AI
competencies.definition: Use AI to generate or explore design concepts, variants, copy, or creative assets.
include_when: An AI method/tool is explicitly connected to ideation, concept exploration, or generation of design alternatives or creative material.
exclude_when: AI product context alone; ordinary design ideation; assuming executable prototypes from generated assets.
minimum_evidence: An AI method/tool is explicitly connected to ideation, concept exploration, or generation of design alternatives or creative material.

competencies.title: Prototype with AI coding tools
competencies.definition: Use AI coding tools to create working/code-based design prototypes.
include_when: An explicit AI coding/tool link to working or coded prototypes. Familiarity with this activity is recorded as understanding, not execution.
exclude_when: Image/wireframe generation without code; generic AI prototyping with no code/working-interface evidence; assuming production shipping.
minimum_evidence: An explicit AI coding/tool link to working or coded prototypes. Familiarity with this activity is recorded as understanding, not execution.

competencies.title: Prototype with existing code and components
competencies.definition: Use AI to create prototypes grounded in an existing product codebase or design system.
include_when: Both AI-assisted prototyping and use of actual existing code/components/design-system material are explicit.
exclude_when: Generic code prototypes; design-system work without AI prototyping; requiring both codebase and components when one clearly establishes grounding.
minimum_evidence: Both AI-assisted prototyping and use of actual existing code/components/design-system material are explicit.

competencies.title: Refine and ship AI-assisted UI code
competencies.definition: Use AI coding tools in implementing, refining, or shipping production interfaces.
include_when: AI-assisted coding is linked to production implementation or shipping the designed interface, with hands-on or explicit collaborative involvement.
exclude_when: Prototype-only work; familiarity with frontend implementation; generic collaboration with engineering; assuming independent production ownership.
minimum_evidence: AI-assisted coding is linked to production implementation or shipping the designed interface, with hands-on or explicit collaborative involvement.

competencies.title: Review AI-generated interfaces
competencies.definition: Assess AI-generated interfaces and identify or make needed design refinements.
include_when: An explicit review/judgment activity concerns AI-generated UI or design output needing interface refinement. Record knowledge-only expectations separately.
exclude_when: Generic AI understanding; merely generating interfaces; assuming a requirement to implement every identified fix.
minimum_evidence: An explicit review/judgment activity concerns AI-generated UI or design output needing interface refinement. Record knowledge-only expectations separately.

competencies.title: Make design systems usable by AI agents
competencies.definition: Structure design-system components, semantics, architecture, or documentation for AI-agent use.
include_when: The role is assigned to make design-system material usable or interpretable by AI tools/agents; company descriptions alone do not establish the role activity.
exclude_when: Ordinary design-system maintenance; a machine-readable system with no AI link; AI-assisted use without agent-facing system work.
minimum_evidence: The role is assigned to make design-system material usable or interpretable by AI tools/agents; company descriptions alone do not establish the role activity.

competencies.title: Create reusable design rules and agent skills
competencies.definition: Create or maintain reusable instructions, rules, skills, or documentation for AI-assisted design implementation.
include_when: Creating or maintaining a reusable AI-consumable design artifact is explicit.
exclude_when: Using a one-off prompt; ordinary design documentation with no AI-consumer link; assuming code implementation when only documentation is assigned.
minimum_evidence: Creating or maintaining a reusable AI-consumable design artifact is explicit.

competencies.title: Design prompts, voice and persona
competencies.definition: Create, configure, or refine prompts, voices, or personas that shape conversational AI behavior.
include_when: At least one role-linked activity shapes conversational AI through prompts, voice selection, or persona configuration.
exclude_when: Using prompts only to generate design assets; ordinary UX copy without AI interaction context; requiring every voice/persona/prompt subactivity.
minimum_evidence: At least one role-linked activity shapes conversational AI through prompts, voice selection, or persona configuration.

competencies.title: Design intent and conversational context
competencies.definition: Design how conversational AI interprets intent or maintains and presents context.
include_when: Intent architecture/routing or conversational memory/context behavior is explicitly assigned to the role.
exclude_when: Generic conversational UI design; assuming memory engineering from an interface-design responsibility; requiring both intent and persistence.
minimum_evidence: Intent architecture/routing or conversational memory/context behavior is explicitly assigned to the role.

competencies.title: Connect conversational and visual experiences
competencies.definition: Design coherent AI experiences across conversation, voice, graphical interfaces, or human-support handoffs.
include_when: An AI experience explicitly spans multiple interaction surfaces or a meaningful handoff, with responsibility for coordinating them.
exclude_when: A single chat interface; unrelated screen design; relying solely on source text marked as suggested/editorial.
minimum_evidence: An AI experience explicitly spans multiple interaction surfaces or a meaningful handoff, with responsibility for coordinating them.

competencies.title: Design delegation and human control
competencies.definition: Design agent authority and the means for people to approve, intervene in, or recover control of AI actions.
include_when: Concrete agent-action boundaries or user-control mechanisms are explicit.
exclude_when: General agency, transparency, or trust language without a control/delegation mechanism; AI-output review in the designer’s own work.
minimum_evidence: Concrete agent-action boundaries or user-control mechanisms are explicit.

competencies.title: Design AI states and recovery
competencies.definition: Design how an interface communicates AI execution states, uncertainty, failures, or recovery.
include_when: At least one AI-specific interaction state or recovery behavior is assigned for interface design.
exclude_when: Generic loading states with no AI link; general trust claims; assuming all lifecycle states are required.
minimum_evidence: At least one AI-specific interaction state or recovery behavior is assigned for interface design.

competencies.title: Design for appropriate reliance
competencies.definition: Design human review or interaction patterns to address overreliance, automation bias, or review fatigue in AI use.
include_when: An explicit reliance-related issue or meaningful human-review problem is tied to design action.
exclude_when: Generic trustworthy AI; any human-in-the-loop mention without a reliance/review-design issue; ordinary usability work.
minimum_evidence: An explicit reliance-related issue or meaningful human-review problem is tied to design action.

competencies.title: Develop AI evals and regression checks
competencies.definition: Develop or contribute to evaluation frameworks, quality tests, or regression checks for AI interactions.
include_when: An explicit evaluation/testing contribution concerns AI or conversational quality; record the particular test artifact and participation level.
exclude_when: Generic usability testing; prompt writing alone; assuming sole ownership or requiring both evaluation and regression testing.
minimum_evidence: An explicit evaluation/testing contribution concerns AI or conversational quality; record the particular test artifact and participation level.

competencies.title: Use live interaction data to improve agents
competencies.definition: Analyze live AI interactions and use the evidence to improve agent behavior or experience.
include_when: Interaction/conversation evidence from AI use is linked to diagnosing behavior or informing improvements.
exclude_when: High-level adoption metrics alone; general analytics without an AI interaction link; assuming AI is used for the analysis.
minimum_evidence: Interaction/conversation evidence from AI use is linked to diagnosing behavior or informing improvements.

competencies.title: Build shared AI design tools
competencies.definition: Build or develop reusable AI-powered tools or workflows for design work.
include_when: Creating tools/workflows for design use is explicit and AI-linked; exploratory building qualifies with exploration recorded.
exclude_when: Personal use of packaged AI tools; generic AI evangelism; assuming an organizational rollout from an exploratory tool.
minimum_evidence: Creating tools/workflows for design use is explicit and AI-linked; exploratory building qualifies with exploration recorded.

competencies.title: Develop and govern AI design workflows
competencies.definition: Develop organizational practices for adopting, governing, or measuring AI-assisted design workflows.
include_when: At least one concrete organization/team-level activity is explicit: pilot implementation, standards/governance, adoption measurement, scaling, or retirement.
exclude_when: Individual AI tool use; hiring-process AI; general organizational metrics without an AI design-workflow link. Do not require a complete pilot-to-retirement sequence.
minimum_evidence: At least one concrete organization/team-level activity is explicit: pilot implementation, standards/governance, adoption measurement, scaling, or retirement.

competencies.title: Understand AI capabilities and limits
competencies.definition: Understand model capabilities and constraints sufficiently to inform AI interaction design.
include_when: A role-specific expectation links knowledge of AI capabilities/limits to design decisions or technical collaboration.
exclude_when: Company AI branding; broad AI enthusiasm; assuming model engineering, evaluations, or implementation skills.
minimum_evidence: A role-specific expectation links knowledge of AI capabilities/limits to design decisions or technical collaboration.

competencies.title: Verify AI-generated evidence and outputs
competencies.definition: Apply explicit quality or safety checks to AI-generated material used in design work.
include_when: At least one concrete check is named: accuracy, bias, source traceability, privacy, or regulatory risk, linked to the designer’s AI-assisted outputs.
exclude_when: Generic craft/judgment language; generating outputs alone; employer recruitment safeguards; requiring every safeguard in the list.
minimum_evidence: At least one concrete check is named: accuracy, bias, source traceability, privacy, or regulatory risk, linked to the designer’s AI-assisted outputs.

competencies.title: Choose when to use AI
competencies.definition: Compare AI approaches with non-AI solutions when defining a product or workflow.
include_when: The role explicitly decides where AI is appropriate versus deterministic software, a UX change, or another non-AI approach.
exclude_when: Prioritizing AI features without an alternative decision; general product strategy at an AI company.
minimum_evidence: The role explicitly decides where AI is appropriate versus deterministic software, a UX change, or another non-AI approach.

competencies.title: Choose models and AI architectures
competencies.definition: Select or contribute to selecting AI models or architectural approaches against product constraints.
include_when: Model/provider or AI-pattern selection is explicitly linked to product needs, quality, cost, latency, or other constraints.
exclude_when: Generic technical fluency; naming tools without selection work; assuming independent architect responsibility.
minimum_evidence: Model/provider or AI-pattern selection is explicitly linked to product needs, quality, cost, latency, or other constraints.

competencies.title: Manage AI unit economics and pricing
competencies.definition: Assess AI operating economics or AI-product pricing models.
include_when: Inference cost/economics, token economics, or consumption-based pricing is explicitly linked to AI systems/products.
exclude_when: Ordinary product pricing or profitability; pricing algorithms using ML without AI operating-cost evidence; assuming both inference economics and pricing are required.
minimum_evidence: Inference cost/economics, token economics, or consumption-based pricing is explicitly linked to AI systems/products.

competencies.title: Define AI success criteria and evals
competencies.definition: Define or contribute to measurable acceptance criteria, evaluation cases, or quality thresholds for AI behavior.
include_when: An explicit role contribution translates expectations into AI evaluation criteria or measurable acceptance conditions.
exclude_when: Generic KPIs; company AI positioning; merely understanding an evaluation; requiring sole ownership.
minimum_evidence: An explicit role contribution translates expectations into AI evaluation criteria or measurable acceptance conditions.

competencies.title: Diagnose AI failures
competencies.definition: Investigate AI failures and distinguish plausible causes to inform corrective action.
include_when: Explicit diagnostic/root-cause work concerning AI behavior, retrieval, representations, or comparable failures.
exclude_when: Understanding evaluations or discussing trade-offs without diagnostic action; generic debugging; assuming causal diagnosis from a tool list.
minimum_evidence: Explicit diagnostic/root-cause work concerning AI behavior, retrieval, representations, or comparable failures.

competencies.title: Set AI release and regression criteria
competencies.definition: Define release acceptance or regression checks for AI-system changes.
include_when: AI-related release gating, regression testing, or backtesting against relevant cases is explicitly assigned.
exclude_when: Generic release management; AI evaluation without release/regression linkage; assuming full autonomy from a release threshold.
minimum_evidence: AI-related release gating, regression testing, or backtesting against relevant cases is explicitly assigned.

competencies.title: Turn production feedback into AI improvements
competencies.definition: Use production/user evidence and evaluation results to prioritize or specify AI improvements.
include_when: A feedback-to-improvement connection is explicit for an AI system, agent, or orchestration workflow.
exclude_when: Generic customer feedback; deployment alone; assuming the PM performs every analysis or writes the fix.
minimum_evidence: A feedback-to-improvement connection is explicit for an AI system, agent, or orchestration workflow.

competencies.title: Specify agent orchestration
competencies.definition: Define how an AI-agent workflow coordinates actions, tools, conditions, or handoffs.
include_when: At least one orchestration element is specified for agents: triggers, tool/action chaining, state, handoffs, exceptions, or checkpoints.
exclude_when: Generic agent knowledge without a named orchestration expectation; ordinary workflow mapping with no AI link; assuming implementation ownership.
minimum_evidence: At least one orchestration element is specified for agents: triggers, tool/action chaining, state, handoffs, exceptions, or checkpoints.

competencies.title: Set agent permissions and escalation
competencies.definition: Specify authorization boundaries or approval/escalation mechanisms for AI-agent actions.
include_when: AI-agent permissions, confirmation/approval, action authority, or escalation to people is explicit.
exclude_when: General governance or security; company claims of safety; confusing the PM’s own approval workflow with customer-agent controls.
minimum_evidence: AI-agent permissions, confirmation/approval, action authority, or escalation to people is explicit.

competencies.title: Make products accessible to AI agents
competencies.definition: Define product tools, actions, or integrations that external AI assistants and agents can use.
include_when: An explicit product capability exposes actions or integrations to customer/external AI agents or assistants.
exclude_when: Using AI for the PM’s own work; generic APIs; MCP familiarity alone without a relevant product responsibility.
minimum_evidence: An explicit product capability exposes actions or integrations to customer/external AI agents or assistants.

competencies.title: Stage AI autonomy and rollout
competencies.definition: Set conditions for progressing an AI workflow between levels of autonomy or rollout.
include_when: A role-linked decision ties advancing autonomy/rollout to readiness criteria such as trust, accuracy, adoption, or risk.
exclude_when: A vision of eventual autonomy without a role-linked gating decision; treating a future ambition as an operational deployment.
minimum_evidence: A role-linked decision ties advancing autonomy/rollout to readiness criteria such as trust, accuracy, adoption, or risk.

competencies.title: Build prototypes with AI
competencies.definition: Use AI tools to create working concepts, prototypes, or proofs of concept in the PM’s work, including internal tooling.
include_when: The PM uses AI tools in creating a prototype or proof of concept. Purpose and code/production status are separately recorded.
exclude_when: A prototype of an AI product without AI-assisted creation; generic prototyping; assuming product-validation purpose or production delivery.
minimum_evidence: The PM uses AI tools in creating a prototype or proof of concept. Purpose and code/production status are separately recorded.

competencies.title: Use spec-driven development with AI
competencies.definition: Use AI to develop specifications or coordinate specification-led product development.
include_when: AI-assisted specification generation or an explicitly AI spec-driven development workflow is assigned to the PM.
exclude_when: Generic specification writing; AI prototyping without specification work; human review alone; assuming the PM independently ships code.
minimum_evidence: AI-assisted specification generation or an explicitly AI spec-driven development workflow is assigned to the PM.

competencies.title: Build reusable agents for PM work
competencies.definition: Create or customize reusable AI agents, skills, prompt patterns, or multi-step workflows for PM activities.
include_when: Explicit construction/customization of reusable AI workflows for research, analysis, or documentation.
exclude_when: Packaged AI tool use; one-off prompting; verifying AI output without construction; assuming internal-source integration is always required.
minimum_evidence: Explicit construction/customization of reusable AI workflows for research, analysis, or documentation.

competencies.title: Use AI for customer and market synthesis
competencies.definition: Use AI to analyze or synthesize customer, behavioral, market, or competitor evidence for product work.
include_when: AI is explicitly applied to relevant research, analysis, summarization, or synthesis in the PM’s workflow.
exclude_when: AI features that summarize data for customers; generic company AI positioning; automatically adding human review or source verification.
minimum_evidence: AI is explicitly applied to relevant research, analysis, summarization, or synthesis in the PM’s workflow.

competencies.title: Translate domain expertise into AI behavior
competencies.definition: Translate domain-specific distinctions or exceptions into the rules, prompts, or structures of an AI system.
include_when: An explicit translation/encoding action connects domain knowledge to AI behavior, prompts, agents, rules, or data structures.
exclude_when: Domain knowledge alone; general strategy at a domain-AI company; assuming all implementation is performed by the PM.
minimum_evidence: An explicit translation/encoding action connects domain knowledge to AI behavior, prompts, agents, rules, or data structures.

competencies.title: Define AI-ready data and semantics
competencies.definition: Specify data meaning, structure, quality, or interfaces that support AI use.
include_when: A role-specific data/semantic specification or assessment explicitly supports AI grounding, inference, or agent use.
exclude_when: Broad product ownership at a company with a knowledge graph; generic analytics data work; assuming AI linkage from company context alone.
minimum_evidence: A role-specific data/semantic specification or assessment explicitly supports AI grounding, inference, or agent use.

competencies.title: Specify retrieval and grounded answers
competencies.definition: Define or contribute requirements for AI retrieval, grounding, citations, or use of domain knowledge.
include_when: A role-linked specification or collaboration activity explicitly concerns retrieval augmentation, answer grounding/citation accuracy, or client-specific AI context.
exclude_when: Repository maintenance with no AI-answer behavior; merely knowing RAG; assuming independent RAG implementation or measured accuracy.
minimum_evidence: A role-linked specification or collaboration activity explicitly concerns retrieval augmentation, answer grounding/citation accuracy, or client-specific AI context.

competencies.title: Define AI governance controls
competencies.definition: Translate AI governance requirements into operational controls or product practices.
include_when: Concrete AI-linked controls, guardrails, audit trails, versioning, or release practices are explicitly assigned.
exclude_when: General responsible-AI rhetoric; ordinary compliance without an AI link; assuming legal compliance has been demonstrated.
minimum_evidence: Concrete AI-linked controls, guardrails, audit trails, versioning, or release practices are explicitly assigned.

competencies.title: Analyze customer and marketing data with AI
competencies.definition: Use AI to analyze or synthesize customer feedback, market research, competitive information, audience evidence, or marketing/commercial-performance data.
include_when: The passage links AI to gathering, analyzing, or synthesizing specified customer, audience, competitor, market, campaign, or commercial-performance information.
exclude_when: General data-driven marketing; describing an analytics or AI product; unspecified AI familiarity; AI audience targeting without a research or evidence activity.
minimum_evidence: The passage links AI to gathering, analyzing, or synthesizing specified customer, audience, competitor, market, campaign, or commercial-performance information.

competencies.title: Develop marketing plans and concepts with AI
competencies.definition: Use AI to develop marketing strategy, briefs, positioning, campaign concepts, or plans.
include_when: AI is explicitly linked to creating or exploring a marketing plan, strategy, brief, positioning, or campaign concept.
exclude_when: A strategy for adopting AI tools; a go-to-market plan for an AI product; content generation alone; generic strategic thinking.
minimum_evidence: AI is explicitly linked to creating or exploring a marketing plan, strategy, brief, positioning, or campaign concept.

competencies.title: Use synthetic audiences and customer simulations
competencies.definition: Create, use, or evaluate AI-generated personas, synthetic audiences, simulated customers, or modeled customer journeys for marketing decisions.
include_when: The passage names synthetic or simulated customer/audience behavior and establishes an AI link.
exclude_when: Traditional personas, lookalike targeting, predictive scoring, or survey respondents without explicit synthetic/simulation evidence; AI-moderated human interviews.
minimum_evidence: The passage names synthetic or simulated customer/audience behavior and establishes an AI link.

competencies.title: Develop go-to-market strategy for AI products
competencies.definition: Position, launch, communicate, or market a product or service explicitly identified as AI-enabled.
include_when: A role responsibility or qualification explicitly concerns positioning, launching, messaging, or marketing an AI-enabled product or service; directly linked full-ad product context can establish its object.
exclude_when: The employer merely calls itself an AI company; generic marketing duties with no definite link to its AI product; using AI to create marketing work.
minimum_evidence: A role responsibility or qualification explicitly concerns positioning, launching, messaging, or marketing an AI-enabled product or service; directly linked full-ad product context can establish its object.

competencies.title: Apply AI to personalized customer experiences
competencies.definition: Use or shape AI-driven personalization, recommendations, next-best actions, or dynamic experiences across marketing and commerce touchpoints.
include_when: A named customer-experience personalization or recommendation activity is explicitly AI-linked.
exclude_when: Generic personalization, segmentation, CRM, or lifecycle marketing with no AI link; a product description with no role responsibility.
minimum_evidence: A named customer-experience personalization or recommendation activity is explicitly AI-linked.

competencies.title: Shape conversational AI customer experiences
competencies.definition: Design, deploy, optimize, or oversee customer-facing conversational AI, assistants, chatbots, or agents for marketing, engagement, or commerce.
include_when: An explicit AI/conversational automation mechanism is linked to a customer-facing marketing or commerce experience and this role.
exclude_when: Using ChatGPT internally; sales outreach automation without conversational interaction; generic chatbot employer descriptions.
minimum_evidence: An explicit AI/conversational automation mechanism is linked to a customer-facing marketing or commerce experience and this role.

competencies.title: Evaluate AI-driven marketing experiences
competencies.definition: Experiment on, evaluate, or set success criteria for AI-driven marketing experiences, recommendations, or customer interactions.
include_when: Testing, experimentation, quality evaluation, or success criteria are linked specifically to an AI experience or system.
exclude_when: Ordinary campaign A/B tests without AI linkage; using AI to analyze test results alone; generic measurement of an AI product business.
minimum_evidence: Testing, experimentation, quality evaluation, or success criteria are linked specifically to an AI experience or system.

competencies.title: Build marketing prototypes with AI
competencies.definition: Use AI tools to build marketing or commerce prototypes, demos, mockups, or proofs of concept.
include_when: AI is explicitly used to create a prototype, demonstration, mockup, or proof of concept; retain stated purpose and do not infer production delivery.
exclude_when: Generating finished campaign content alone; describing a product demo without evidence that AI helps build it; familiarity with prototypes.
minimum_evidence: AI is explicitly used to create a prototype, demonstration, mockup, or proof of concept; retain stated purpose and do not infer production delivery.

competencies.title: Create and adapt marketing content with AI
competencies.definition: Use AI to generate, edit, repurpose, or adapt marketing copy, imagery, video, creative assets, or campaign content.
include_when: AI is explicitly linked to producing, editing, repurposing, or adapting a named marketing content or creative artifact.
exclude_when: General content creation or creative direction with no AI link; messaging an AI product; localization can additionally receive M10 when explicit.
minimum_evidence: AI is explicitly linked to producing, editing, repurposing, or adapting a named marketing content or creative artifact.

competencies.title: Localize marketing with AI
competencies.definition: Use or implement AI for translation, localization, transcreation, or cultural adaptation of marketing materials and experiences.
include_when: An explicit AI link to localization, translation, transcreation, or regional/cultural adaptation of marketing work.
exclude_when: Global or regional marketing experience alone; generic content adaptation with no regional/language component; multilingual AI-product marketing alone.
minimum_evidence: An explicit AI link to localization, translation, transcreation, or regional/cultural adaptation of marketing work.

competencies.title: Optimize channels and campaigns with AI
competencies.definition: Use AI-powered targeting, bidding, channel allocation, search optimization, campaign optimization, lead scoring, or marketing decision systems.
include_when: AI is explicitly linked to a named targeting, search, channel, campaign, scoring, or allocation action; a named platform alone is insufficient.
exclude_when: Marketing automation, analytics, ad platforms, SEO, or A/B testing without explicit AI linkage; generic AI familiarity; marketing an AI optimization product.
minimum_evidence: AI is explicitly linked to a named targeting, search, channel, campaign, scoring, or allocation action; a named platform alone is insufficient.

competencies.title: Enable partners and teams to market with AI
competencies.definition: Train, coach, equip, or enable partners, agencies, retailers, sellers, or marketing teams to use AI capabilities in their work.
include_when: AI use or capability is linked to enabling other people through training, playbooks, coaching, tools, or partner programs.
exclude_when: Individual tool use; partner marketing for an AI product without AI-use enablement; using existing partner AI tools is not building those tools.
minimum_evidence: AI use or capability is linked to enabling other people through training, playbooks, coaching, tools, or partner programs.

competencies.title: Optimize content for AI search and discovery
competencies.definition: Adapt, optimize, measure, or plan marketing content and digital presence for generative search, answer engines, AI recommendations, or AI-mediated discovery.
include_when: An advertised role activity explicitly concerns AI-search visibility, answer/generative-engine optimization, or discovery through AI systems. Record whether the marketer actually uses AI tools separately.
exclude_when: Ordinary SEO without AI linkage; simply using AI to perform SEO research; employer branding about AI; do not infer personal AI-tool use from AI-search visibility.
minimum_evidence: An advertised role activity explicitly concerns AI-search visibility, answer/generative-engine optimization, or discovery through AI systems. Record whether the marketer actually uses AI tools separately.

competencies.title: Build AI marketing workflows and agents
competencies.definition: Build, configure, integrate, or automate repeatable marketing workflows using AI tools, agents, prompts, scripts, or integrations.
include_when: The passage explicitly links AI to construction/configuration/integration of repeatable marketing workflows or agents; normal tool use does not establish building.
exclude_when: Generic marketing automation without AI; adoption or oversight of an existing agent; one-off prompting without reusable workflow evidence.
minimum_evidence: The passage explicitly links AI to construction/configuration/integration of repeatable marketing workflows or agents; normal tool use does not establish building.

competencies.title: Prepare marketing data and knowledge for AI
competencies.definition: Create, curate, integrate, or govern the customer data, knowledge, brand information, or measurement infrastructure used by AI marketing systems.
include_when: A specified data/knowledge infrastructure activity has an explicit AI application or consumer.
exclude_when: CRM, CDP, data quality, dashboards, or knowledge management with no AI link; individual analysis of customer data alone.
minimum_evidence: A specified data/knowledge infrastructure activity has an explicit AI application or consumer.

competencies.title: Lead AI adoption in marketing
competencies.definition: Identify, evaluate, pilot, adopt, or scale AI capabilities across marketing processes or teams.
include_when: An organizational marketing AI adoption activity or responsibility is explicit; retain explore/pilot/operate only when the source supports that stage.
exclude_when: Personal curiosity or generic AI fluency; simply using a tool for one task; company-level AI ambition without a responsibility for this role.
minimum_evidence: An organizational marketing AI adoption activity or responsibility is explicit; retain explore/pilot/operate only when the source supports that stage.

competencies.title: Verify AI-generated marketing outputs
competencies.definition: Check AI-generated marketing work for factual accuracy, evidence, brand quality, bias, suitability, or other explicitly stated quality criteria.
include_when: A review, verification, quality-control, or human-judgment action is explicitly linked to AI-generated output.
exclude_when: AI-assisted generation or synthesis alone; generic attention to detail; brand stewardship without an AI-output link; governance policies without output review.
minimum_evidence: A review, verification, quality-control, or human-judgment action is explicitly linked to AI-generated output.

competencies.title: Set safeguards for AI marketing
competencies.definition: Define or apply safeguards for privacy, consent, copyright, bias, legal compliance, disclosure, accountability, or human oversight in marketing AI use.
include_when: A named risk, safeguard, policy, governance, or oversight responsibility is explicitly linked to marketing AI.
exclude_when: Generic marketing compliance or responsible behavior with no AI link; recruitment AI disclosure; output verification alone unless a safeguard is also explicit.
minimum_evidence: A named risk, safeguard, policy, governance, or oversight responsibility is explicitly linked to marketing AI.

competencies.title: Measure the value of marketing AI adoption
competencies.definition: Assess the productivity, quality, commercial, customer, or organizational outcomes of adopting AI in marketing work.
include_when: Measurement or evaluation is explicitly about the impact/value of adopting or using AI in marketing processes, teams, or experiences.
exclude_when: Generic marketing ROI or analytics with no AI link; promised benefits in employer branding; revenue metrics for an AI product alone.
minimum_evidence: Measurement or evaluation is explicitly about the impact/value of adopting or using AI in marketing processes, teams, or experiences.

competencies.title: Build analytics tools with AI coding
competencies.definition: Use AI coding tools or vibe coding to create dashboards, reports, scripts, or internal analytics applications for marketing work.
include_when: Building a marketing analytics artifact is explicitly linked to AI-assisted coding or vibe coding, either directly or through directly linked full-ad context. Preserve packaged-tool alternatives; a typo such as vide code alone is an unresolved recall lead.
exclude_when: Using a packaged dashboard; ordinary coding without AI linkage; using an existing AI analytics tool; prototypes without analytics purpose; generic AI workflow automation; do not infer production deployment.
minimum_evidence: Building a marketing analytics artifact is explicitly linked to AI-assisted coding or vibe coding, either directly or through directly linked full-ad context. Preserve packaged-tool alternatives; a typo such as vide code alone is an unresolved recall lead.

competencies.title: LLM foundations
competencies.definition: Knowledge or applied use of LLM behavior, prompting, model selection, context windows, or transformer/foundation-model capabilities.
include_when: An explicit role duty or knowledge requirement involving LLMs, prompting, or foundation models.
exclude_when: A tool name alone or company AI branding is not LLM foundations.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Grounding models with data
competencies.definition: Ground an AI model in external information through retrieval, embeddings, vector search, knowledge sources, or retrieval-augmented generation.
include_when: A role-linked RAG, grounding, retrieval/embedding, or vector-search requirement tied to AI.
exclude_when: Ordinary database administration and information retrieval without AI linkage are excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Building agentic systems
competencies.definition: Build or design AI agents, tool-using models, agent orchestration, or multi-agent applications.
include_when: Agent implementation, orchestration, agent architecture, or named agent frameworks in duties or qualifications.
exclude_when: Using a coding assistant alone is not building an agentic system; sales/customer agents and ordinary software daemons are excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Evaluation-driven development
competencies.definition: Develop or apply evaluations of AI/model outputs to guide application quality and iteration.
include_when: Explicit AI evaluation, model benchmarking, eval datasets, hallucination tests, or model-output quality measurement.
exclude_when: Generic software testing, system performance testing, or interviewing candidates is excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Operating in production
competencies.definition: Deploy, serve, monitor, optimize, or maintain AI models and applications in production.
include_when: AI/model serving, inference infrastructure, MLOps/LLMOps, production model deployment, or AI observability.
exclude_when: Generic deployment or production work without AI linkage belongs to software fundamentals.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Machine learning foundations
competencies.definition: Understand or apply machine-learning methods, training, statistical learning, model architectures, or learning frameworks.
include_when: Explicit ML-method or framework knowledge/application in duties or qualifications.
exclude_when: Company-level AI claims alone, general analytics, and generic tool enthusiasm are excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Building full-stack applications
competencies.definition: Build software applications, including front-end, back-end, full-stack, web, or mobile components and APIs.
include_when: Specific application/component development or relevant front/back/mobile/web development qualifications.
exclude_when: Generic familiarity with software or employer product descriptions alone are excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Managing data
competencies.definition: Design, transform, store, or manage data used by software systems.
include_when: Database, schema, data pipeline, ETL, data modeling, or storage engineering duties/qualifications.
exclude_when: Merely reading data or a product being data-driven is excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Designing system architectures
competencies.definition: Design system-level software architecture, services, integrations, or distributed-system structures.
include_when: Software/distributed-system architecture or design responsibilities/knowledge.
exclude_when: Architectural roles for buildings or hardware alone are excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Making systems secure and reliable
competencies.definition: Engineer and verify secure, reliable software, including testing, debugging, resilience, and software security.
include_when: Explicit software testing, debugging, secure development, reliability, or security engineering.
exclude_when: Corporate security policies and generic culture language alone are excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Scaling and operating in production
competencies.definition: Scale, deploy, operate, and maintain software systems, infrastructure, CI/CD, or service observability.
include_when: Explicit production software operations, deployment, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or scaling.
exclude_when: Operating machinery, nonsoftware field service, or company scale alone is excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Directing the workflow
competencies.definition: Direct AI coding assistants by decomposing tasks, prompting, providing context, and managing an AI-assisted development workflow.
include_when: Explicit use or direction of a coding agent/assistant for coding tasks.
exclude_when: Building an AI customer-facing product does not establish using AI to write its code.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Enabling agent autonomy
competencies.definition: Delegate multi-step software work to coding agents with suitable tools, permissions, environments, or supervision.
include_when: Explicit autonomous coding-agent workflows, agent delegation, or multi-step agent execution in development.
exclude_when: A generic coding-assistant tool mention or a product-side autonomous agent does not suffice.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Reviewing the work
competencies.definition: Review, test, debug, validate, or verify code or changes generated by AI coding tools.
include_when: An explicit link between AI-generated coding output and human review/testing/verification.
exclude_when: Ordinary code review or AI recruiting assessment is excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Customizing the agent and its environment
competencies.definition: Configure or customize coding agents with development context, tools, integrations, instructions, or environments.
include_when: Explicit coding-agent customization, rules/context files, development tool integrations, or MCP integrations for coding.
exclude_when: Generic model customization or product agents without software-development purpose is excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Coding agent foundations
competencies.definition: Understand AI coding tools and their capabilities, limitations, or effective use.
include_when: Role-linked experience/familiarity with named AI coding assistants or explicit AI-assisted software-development tools.
exclude_when: AI enthusiasm, employer subscriptions, or optional recruiting-tool access alone are excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Driving the build loop
competencies.definition: Drive iterative software delivery from feedback through implementation, testing, release, and improvement.
include_when: Explicit iterative delivery, experimentation, feedback-led development, or end-to-end build/release cycles.
exclude_when: A generic mention of an agile workplace or continuous improvement alone is excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Making product decisions
competencies.definition: Make software-product choices using customer needs, requirements, prioritization, user evidence, or tradeoffs.
include_when: Explicit responsibility to shape product requirements/priorities or make product tradeoffs with user/business context.
exclude_when: Pure task execution without product-decision involvement is excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: Communicating and leading
competencies.definition: Communicate technical decisions and coordinate, mentor, or lead colleagues in software delivery.
include_when: Technical communication/collaboration, engineering mentorship, or team leadership expectations.
exclude_when: Company teamwork slogans alone are excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.

competencies.title: High-agency ownership
competencies.definition: Take initiative and ownership for software outcomes, including ambiguous problems and delivery across boundaries.
include_when: Explicit autonomous ownership, initiative, proactive problem-solving, or end-to-end accountability.
exclude_when: Generic company values such as entrepreneurial culture without a candidate expectation are excluded.
minimum_evidence: An exact role-linked duty or qualification span; company/product context and recruiting instructions alone are excluded.
